breakdown.description: Hydraulic jump is asserted for subcritical upstream flow (Fr1=0.5), which contradicts the condition Fr1>1 for a jump.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains Fr1 = 0.5, which is subcritical flow. A hydraulic jump requires supercritical upstream flow (Fr1 > 1). The ground truth corrects this to Fr1 = 2.0. The agent did not identify or fix this physical inconsistency and repeated the original error.
